facts.title: Pokémon the Movie 2000

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With nature's equilibrium fracturing across the globe, can Ash intervene before Lugia is captured?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: When a rogue collector schemes to capture the Legendary Pokémon Lugia, the balance of nature collapses, forcing Ash Ketchum and his companions into a worldwide crisis directed by Kunihiko Yuyama.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Exciting, steady-paced anime adventure built on accessible family stakes and high fantasy spectacle.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Kunihiko Yuyama stages a brisk, exciting fantasy adventure where grand environmental stakes meet the classic energy of an accessible anime quest.
